links.title: Solvari homepage
links.relevance: Advertises homeowner matching and the Joost AI assistant. The public interface establishes the assistant’s existence, not its model provider or internal design.

links.title: User terms
links.relevance: Positions Solvari as an intermediary; the work agreement is directly between user and professional. Discusses matching parameters, AI support, and human review.

links.title: Trust and professional checks
links.relevance: Describes business registration, identity/contact checks, blacklist screening, and experience feedback. These checks do not establish a guarantee of workmanship.

groups.description: How demand access, workflow support, and compensation are described publicly.

links.title: Solvari Pro offer
links.relevance: Describes professional demand access, account support, company profiles, and communication with leads.

links.title: Packages and credit bundles
links.relevance: Shows package-dependent marketplace and campaign access, CRM, APIs, support, and credit bundles. Starter presentation and bundle arithmetic are ambiguous; no universal tariff is encoded.

links.title: Professional terms
links.relevance: Defines packages, campaigns, credits, lead pricing, and the effective order form. Access does not guarantee a won job or investment return.

links.title: Affiliate programme
links.relevance: Offers embedded forms and API submission, compensation per lead, a dashboard, and monthly payment; covers Dutch and Belgian demand.

links.title: Privacy statement
links.relevance: Explains project and property data, recipient sharing, automated matching, review rights, and data-use purposes. Describes up to four professionals with more at the user’s request.

links.title: Solvari investment
links.relevance: Lists a 2018 buyout and current investment; reports more than 60% recurring revenue and support for five strategic acquisitions. No reporting period is stated for the revenue mix.

links.title: About Solvari
links.relevance: Reports 2+ million successful applications, 6,004 affiliated specialists, and 100+ employees. These are undated page counters, not annual volumes or measured active users.

links.title: Offerte.nl acquisition announcement
links.relevance: Places Offerte.nl inside the group and names earlier acquired brands. Calls this the sixth acquisition in three years; a EUR 40m 2024 revenue statement is a forecast, not realized revenue.
